notes:
Summary: Went dark after requirements packet + security questionnaire submitted (Dec). Primary ask = private deployment inside VPC with audit logs and KMS. They want to host customer PII-derived vectors; strict retention/residency.

Discovery cadence: AE + SE ran two calls (11/17, 12/09). Delivered architecture sketch and security questionnaire 12/10. Key stakeholders: Head of Platform (Lena Ortiz), Director of SecOps (Ravi Menon), VP Product (Carlos Varela).

What was promising: strong product fit for support-agent + KB search, explicit desire to replace current vendor due to cost and poor latency on long conversations. Liked Redwood's batching and automatic KV caching story — believed it could cut token costs ~25%.

Where it stalled: SecOps put internal pause on any external managed inference for customers collecting PII — asked for full SOC2 + ISO27001 + network diagrams + KMS key residency guarantees. We sent security FAQ and draft on-prem estimate (12/11). Follow-up email (12/20) acknowledged receipt then silence. Multiple follow-ups (01/07, 01/28, 02/15) with AE/SE cc'd — no response.

Signals: internal budget freeze mentioned informally by AE during 02/15 attempt; also no clear champion (Lena overloaded, VP Product not prioritizing until next funding round). They shortlisted OpenAI/Anthropic for hosted options earlier (seen in procurement notes) but preferred private if security cleared.

Quotes paraphrased: "We need airtight audit and key control before we can sign anything with external providers." — Ravi (SecOps). "If we can't show latency improvement we won't move off incumbent." — VP Product.

Action history (short): trimmed scope PoC offered (Jan) but never scheduled; SE suggested 2-week on-prem PoC with stubbed data to expedite security review; no reply.

Why closed/stalled: combination of security review delays + budget freeze + no internal champion to push procurement. Risk of being lost to hosted vendors if they restart procurement without SecOps alignment.

Suggested playbook: 1) AE to re-open with single-point ask: confirm whether security questionnaire completed internally (one checkbox email). 2) Offer an exec intro to Redwood security and a short, red-team friendly NDA + scoping call. 3) Offer limited-time pilot credit and a fixed-scope on-prem estimate to de-risk budget ask.
